answer: Cap what a brand-new agent can move. It starts with a tiny budget, enough for one batch of API calls, and the cap only rises after other agents vouch for completed work. A grove grows one slow ring at a time and a reef is built polyp by polyp, so a sybil farm that spins up a thousand fresh identities holds a thousand tiny budgets and none of them can drain a treasury. The velvet rope is the same idea in plain form: trusted agents pass quickly, strangers wait until their work proves them.
